pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.body: GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount() is javadoc-documented to 'Never return null', but this override can now return null; any caller (existing or future SPI consumer) that unboxes the result to a primitive long or otherwise assumes non-null will get a NullPointerException, and current callers silently propagate null into REST representations instead of a defined fallback.
raw_findings.evidence:
GroupModel model = modelSupplier.get();
        return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent contract violation that can surface as a NullPointerException or unexpected null value at call sites expecting a non-null Long/long.
raw_findings.impact: GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount() is javadoc-documented to 'Never return null', but this override can now return null; any caller (existing or future SPI consumer) that unboxes the result to a primitive long or otherwise assumes non-null will get a NullPointerException, and current callers silently propagate null into REST representations instead of a defined fallback.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new null-check branch returns null instead of preserving the interface's documented non-null contract.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Return a documented sentinel (e.g. 0L) when the underlying model is concurrently deleted, or update GroupModel#getSubGroupsCount javadoc to allow null and audit/adjust all callers to handle null explicitly instead of silently returning null from this override.
raw_findings.title: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() now returns null, violating GroupModel contract
raw_findings.trigger: A group is deleted by another thread/session between the time the cached GroupAdapter is obtained and getSubGroupsCount() is invoked, causing modelSupplier.get() (delegating to getGroupById) to return null.

raw_findings.body: The test can complete and pass (assertThat executed) before the background thread has a chance to observe and record a concurrent exception, producing a false negative that hides the very concurrency regression this test intends to catch.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Non-deterministic/flaky test that can silently pass despite a real concurrency bug in the reader path.
raw_findings.impact: The test can complete and pass (assertThat executed) before the background thread has a chance to observe and record a concurrent exception, producing a false negative that hides the very concurrency regression this test intends to catch.
raw_findings.root_cause: Missing synchronization between the main test thread and the spawned background reader thread before evaluating shared mutable state (caughtExceptions).
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Capture the Thread instance and call thread.join() (with a timeout) after deletedAll.set(true) and before asserting caughtExceptions is empty, or use an ExecutorService with awaitTermination.
raw_findings.title: New concurrency test asserts exceptions without joining the background reader thread
raw_findings.trigger: After all groups are deleted, deletedAll is set to true, but the background reader Thread is not joined; it may still be mid-execution of managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...) when the assertion below runs.

finding.title: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() now returns null, violating GroupModel contract
finding.trigger: A group is deleted by another thread/session between the time the cached GroupAdapter is obtained and getSubGroupsCount() is invoked, causing modelSupplier.get() (delegating to getGroupById) to return null.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch at line 274-275 introduces `return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`. The interface javadoc at GroupModel.java:296 explicitly states 'Never returns null'. Callers like GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount (line 90) pass the result directly to setSubGroupCount without null handling. If modelSupplier.get() returns null due to concurrent deletion, this violates the documented contract and can cause NPE when callers unbox or propagate null unexpectedly.

finding.root_cause: Missing synchronization between the main test thread and the spawned background reader thread before evaluating shared mutable state (caughtExceptions).

finding.title: New concurrency test asserts exceptions without joining the background reader thread
finding.trigger: After all groups are deleted, deletedAll is set to true, but the background reader Thread is not joined; it may still be mid-execution of managedRealm.admin().groups().groups(...) when the assertion below runs.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch shows the test spawns a thread at line 149 with `.start()`, sets deletedAll at line 155, then immediately asserts caughtExceptions at line 157 without joining the thread. The background thread may still be executing the try block when the assertion runs, meaning exceptions could be added after the assertion passes. This is a genuine race condition that can produce false negatives in the concurrency test.
